text:
morgan: Quick heads up — opened PR #2190 touching kvcache typings + a tiny TS rename. CI was green locally but GH actions flagged a lint nit around variable casing and Prettier differences. @shiv can you take a quick look?

shiv: glanced — two main things: prefer camelCase for exported props (public surface), snake_case is fine for internal private vars. Also Prettier will flip some quotes; run `yarn format` before pushing. I can push the naming-rule change (`@typescript-eslint/naming-convention`) if you want me to.

anya: small reminder: do NOT change proto/public API names. If these fields come from the model or external contract, keep names stable. For internal kvcache keys we can rename. For formatting, prefer a dedicated commit with only style changes so diffs are easier.

morgan: good call — these are internal keys only. I'll run formatter and add the eslint rule as a separate commit. Question: do we want to enable auto-apply of formatting on merge via the bot?

format-bot: AutoFormatter: I can apply whitespace/prettier fixes on merge if PR is labeled `auto-format`. To enable: comment `@format-bot label auto-format` or add the label in the UI.

morgan: OK adding the label and will push two commits: 1) eslint rule, 2) run `yarn format` (no logic changes). Avoid touching exported names.

shiv: one tiny nit while you're at it — in eng/src/runtime/kvcache.ts, rename `cache_key` -> `cacheKey` and add a short comment explaining the key normalization. Avoid `/* eslint-disable */` unless absolutely necessary.

morgan: pushed eslint change + formatted files locally, thought I had renamed the var. Pushing the rename now.

ci-bot: CI: lint failure — eng/src/runtime/kvcache.ts: line 42: naming-convention (expected camelCase for identifier `cache_key`).

morgan: hmm, must have missed that occurrence. Re-pushing fix.

morgan: pushed fix (2143654460). Re-ran CI and all green :white_check_mark:.

anya: LGTM. Approving now. Let's add a follow-up task to add a regression test for kvcache key normalization so future changes don't regress.

shiv: approved. Merge when green and squash the formatting commit into a dedicated style commit per policy. :thumbsup:

morgan: will do — thanks all.
